notes.title: 📅💀 Dungeon Deathball has a release date!
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33020952/a0fae03698cbf72072041d3332157d9c314c36ba.gif[/img]

[h1]🏁 Dungeon Deathball is touching down![/h1]

I've been developing the game in Early Access since July 2018. In those 3 years it has undergone countless changes and improvements based on feedback from players around the world. It's now the biggest, deepest and most complex game I've ever made.

And I'm happy to say it's... it's done!

[i]Well, apart from a few finishing touches of course.[/i] 😏

[h2]Dungeon Deathball will transition out of Early Access on 13th October.[/h2]

I've been busy preparing for release, which includes making a fancy new trailer that you can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/861330/Dungeon_Deathball/]watch on the Steam page now! 👀[/url]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33020952/c5780c7f2d7a8c049409e923144d9bee47de4b78.png[/img]

[i]In the meantime, here are some quick things you can do to help the game's chances of success...[/i]

[h3]❤ Add it to your Wishlist[/h3]
If you add Dungeon Deathball to your Wishlist then you will be receive an email notification the moment it is released on Steam.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33020952/2013e408da41f0234784c5b8ff8eb5b03e3d3fe7.gif[/img]

[h3]👍 Leave a Review[/h3]
Already bought Dungeon Deathball in Early Access? Then please remember to leave a review! It really helps to boost the game's visibility and let others know whether it's worth buying.

[h3]👉 Follow me on Steam[/h3]
If you [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/mattglanville]follow me[/url] then you'll be updated of all my new game releases and major news updates.

---

If you're a Curator here on Steam then please get in touch. I'm happy to send out review copies.

That's all for now. See you on launch day!

Matt

notes.title: 🎮 Controller support & more in update 2.2
notes.notes:
How time flies, huh? It's hard to believe it's been a whole year since this game first hit Steam, off the back of the GMTK 2019 game jam. To celebrate a whole year apprehending galactic supercriminals, enjoy this hearty sale on Steam and a new updated version.

[b]Version 2.2 is now available for Singled Out, featuring...[/b]
[list][*]full controller support
[*]improved face readability
[*]many quality-of-life improvements[/list]
Also, of course, those obligatory bug fixes (including a fix for the 50,000 point achievement failing to unlock for all you top-tier players).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35677712/ce68758263e1af4403d505a833becd0fbff764d9.gif[/img]

If you already played the game at launch, be sure to check out some of the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1144150/announcements/detail/1685967148909649938]other new features[/url] added since then.

Read on for the full list of changes.

[url=https://discord.gg/zCyJuy8][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35677712/9af8d0a32eac3cbe589ae852c8f62387b86fa5bc.png[/img][/url]
[i]Did you know I have a [url=https://discord.gg/zCyJuy8]Discord[/url] too? Come and chat about Singled Out, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/mattglanville]my other games[/url] and game development in general![/i]

[h2]🆕 Changes[/h2]
[list][*]Controller, keyboard and touch input now supported. You can hot-swap between methods at any time.
[*]Improved readability of several ear-types and the heart-shaped face type.
[*]Reduced the time it takes to reload.
[*]Faces now appear twice as fast when the level starts.
[*]Character faces now grow slightly when you hover your crosshair over them, to make it clearer which character you're targetting.
[*]Added splash screen during initial loading.
[*]Added icons and animations to the leaderboards during network activity.
[*]Added a second confirmation step when you try to quit your game between levels.
[*]Most menu buttons now have graphical icons.
[*]Added local achievements menu to check progress in-game.
[*]Added comma to long numbers (e.g. 10,000 instead of 10000).
[*]Practice Mode no longer includes the boss level.
[*]Game controls are now displayed when you start a new game.
[*]Added option for controller/keyboard sensitivity.
[*]Added trophy icon to the mode selection menu, which appears when you complete each mode.
[*]Character hit circles are now slightly larger.
[*]Added Unity Analytics so I can better understand how you're all playing.
[*]Screen resolution is now clamped to 720p if 1080p is not supported. This ensures 16:9 aspect ratio so that the interface can be viewed properly.[/list]

[h2]🐛 Bug fixes[/h2]
[list][*]Fixed "Paid in Full" achievement failing to unlock.
[*]Fixed score-based achievements not unlocking if you run out of time.
[*]Fixed score-based achievements trying to unlock too early, before your score is updated.
[*]Text characters which are unsupported by the GUI font are not displayed in leaderboards names, which means they do not fall back to an overly-large font.
[*]Fixed incorrect kill count achievement values.
[*]Fixed 'tag' function not working the first time you try to use it on a character.
[*]Character hit circles no longer scale with their animation.[/list]

[url=http://eepurl.com/gv2FRT][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35677712/bab2161f9e535d034eb6d28149b4ab133325fa75.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/mattglanville][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35677712/d20d0f13c6459a6126731bfbbd58e895b3e445c5.png[/img][/url]

P.S. Did you know Singled Out is now available on Nintendo Switch as well? Find it on the Nintendo eShop and start making your way to the top of those leaderboards too. 😎

notes.title: Update 2.1 now available
notes.notes:
[b]The first major update for Singled Out is here with some new features that I'm excited to reveal![/b]

Many of these changes are in direct response to player feedback. Thank you to everyone who has shared their thoughts and left positive reviews, I really appreciate it! I hope you like the new changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35677712/ce68758263e1af4403d505a833becd0fbff764d9.gif[/img]

[h3]Family Friendly Mode[/h3]
Activate this mode in the new Options menu for a non-violent experience, more suitable for younger players or pacifists. When Family Friendly Mode is enabled targets are caged instead of shot, and all references to death and killing in the game text are removed.

[h3]Practice Mode[/h3]
You can now practice finding supercriminals without the intense pressure of a 10-second time limit! Ideal for beginners to get the hang of the game, or for players who simply enjoy a more relaxed puzzle-style experience.

[h3]Options Menu[/h3]
The game now has an Options menu, like a real big boy grown-up game! You can now adjust the volume levels of the music and sound effects using the sliders, as well as switching between Full Screen and Windowed display modes. Amazing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35677712/b80b27b3c7e433a5511750ec10c7f8229b3674ea.png[/img]

[h3]Improved failure feedback[/h3]
If you shoot the wrong target, you will now get information about where you went wrong. This will help to alleviate any frustration or confusion caused when crowd members look quite similar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35677712/d89e0be9efde837c6040b9a57309344e36d8d291.png[/img]

[h3]Personal High Scores[/h3]
The online leaderboards can now show your personal ranking. This will be displayed by default instead of the global top 10, but you can still switch views at any time.

[h3]Mark Targets with Right Mouse Button[/h3]
You can now right-click on any member of the crowd to 'mark' them. This darkens their sprite a little and is intended to be used to remind yourself when you've checked a face and you're certain that it's not the target (but you can use this tool any way you see fit).

[h3]Other minor improvements[/h3]
[list][*]Innocent civilians are darkened on game over to make it easier to see the real target.
[*]When the target is revealed on game over they will try to move away from the bottom-right corner of the screen so you can get a clear view of them.
[*]The background is darkened slightly on game over.[/list]

[h3]Attempted bug fix for 'Paid in Full' achievement[/h3]
There is [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1144150/discussions/0/1741134804875122615/]an ongoing issue[/url] with the achievement for getting a final score of 50,000. I have implemented an attempted fix for it, which tries to unlock it when the game first starts up if you achieved a high enough score in the past.


That's all for this update! I hope you enjoy these new changes. Please remember to share it with your friends and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/mattglanville]follow my Steam developer page[/url].
